typed: I walk up to the leader of the refugees and look hard at the brand on Flaard's wrist, then ask the traveler to tell their story, and I accuse them of lying to see how they react.
note: Good opening scene. Flaard's brand and the unbelieved story are intriguing. No complaints.
The odds screen is clear. Chance 70%, with the costs listed. "Close call" wording is a bit murky, and the offer is for a mix of looking, asking and accusing at once.
Odds screen is clear. Small oddity: "Learn from the traveler" is the label though I accused them of lying, and going big made the failure danger jump to grave at 5%, which is a nice readable risk.
Near miss screen was clear. Slightly odd that a 70% roll showed "6 vs 9" with no explanation of how the 9 was reached.

typed: I get up, grab the man who shoved me by the collar and swing a fist at his jaw.
note: Outcome was clear and vivid. The result block was easy to follow, though it's a bit odd that I got the "more than you asked" info only as a vague line.

Odds screen is clear. Minor: the offer says "Hold the fight at the gate" though we're in the refugee knot, and the earlier hit said "serious" harm but the guard captain is just running over; fine otherwise.

Pressing Enter just re-showed the same odds screen, which is fine. The "Danger" warning on go-big is clear. Odd that the man is described as a refugee father but I'm punching him; fine, I want danger.

typed: I spit blood, shove Flaard's hand away, and lunge at the man again.
note: Harm hit hard and fast; Vitality 2 now. Description was vivid, odds screens clear.
Odds fell from 55% to 5% after being hurt, with no line saying why (wounds? Flaard?). Badly at 50% looks brutal but I can see the stakes clearly.

typed: I cough and say, "Not liars. Not... the brand. Flaard, who is waiting for them?"
note: Vitality hit 0 and the game just kept going with a prompt, which is fine. Odds dropping from 55% to 5% after one hurt felt steep; the "only by luck" offer was clear though.
